headlines.title: Thousands of migrants force their way into Spain’s African territory
headlines.description: Border guards in the tiny Spanish exclave of Ceuta on the Moroccan coast were overwhelmed as crowds of young men pushed through gates and swam around the border barrier, hoping to gain entry into Europe.

headlines.title: Trump defends ‘anti-weaponization’ fund, further complicating Blanche nomination
headlines.description: President Donald Trump defended his controversial proposal for a $1.8 billion “anti-weaponization fund” for Jan. 6 defendants, complicating Todd Blanche’s nomination.

headlines.title: Trump calls Minnesota 'grossly incompetent' after water system cyberattack
headlines.description: President Trump said he did not believe Iran was behind a cyberattack on Minnesota's water systems, instead casting blame onto the state's government.

headlines.title: Mother fights to have post-pregnancy complication treated
headlines.description: In our series “The Cost of Denial,” NBC News’ Stephanie Gosk reports on the Oregon mother who had to fight for approval to treat the near constant pain she was in due to a common complication many women face following pregnancy.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: North West cancels music tour days before first show
headlines.description: North West has cancelled what would have been her first headlining tour, just months after launching her music career and only days before the first show.

headlines.title: Letters sent to Nancy Guthrie’s family after her disappearance are released
headlines.description: Two ransom notes purportedly sent by those who kidnapped Nancy Guthrie in Arizona earlier this year were released Friday by local authorities hoping to generate new leads in the case.

headlines.title: Decorated Army vet files $3M claim alleging National Guard assault
headlines.description: National Guardsmen shoved a retired Army captain to the pavement in violent retaliation for her opposition to their deployment in Washington D.C., the decorated soldier said in a multi-million administrative claim filed this week.

headlines.title: Judge denies request by Elon Musk’s xAI to pause Minnesota nudification ban
headlines.description: A judge denied a request from Elon Musk’s AI company xAI to block Minnesota’s law that will be the first in the nation to ban nudification technology.

headlines.title: Vermont’s GOP governor defends state-run elections and mail-in voting as Trump aims to reshape them
headlines.description: Vermont’s GOP governor, Phil Scott, defended mail-in voting and state-run elections as a good option for Americans, rejecting Trump’s calls for the Republicans to “nationalize” elections and limit options for mail-in voting.

headlines.title: Immigrant who donated lifesaving kidney to his brother is detained by ICE again
headlines.description: José Gregorio González, who’s been his brother’s caregiver since the kidney transplant, was detained during a routine ICE check-in.
